verdict.rationale: Otter's materials name a public API: the pricing page lists 'Otter API & Webhooks', and the enterprise launch blog promotes 'Custom Integrations with Otter's Public API' for connecting meeting data to any system. An OAuth-authenticated MCP server also gives AI tools programmatic access to meeting data. However, the evidence is only marketing-level mentions with no API reference, and it shows read and export access to meeting data rather than full control of the product. Missing for 10: published API reference docs (endpoints, auth, rate limits), evidence the API can drive product actions beyond data access, clarity on plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
